llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝基复合材料，与生物医学植入物或骨整合方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aluminum matrix composites for non-biomedical applications (aerospace/automotive) and does not address implant stress shielding, osseointegration, or biomedical mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进铝基复合材料的微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备纳米TiB2/SiC增强铝基复合材料。
summary_zh.result: 实现了增强相的均匀分布和力学性能提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过硬度、拉伸和压缩测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the microstructure and mechanical properties of aluminum matrix composites for high-performance applications.
summary_en.method: Nano-sized TiB2 and SiC particles were incorporated into aluminum via selective laser melting to fabricate reinforced composites.
summary_en.result: The composite exhibited improved hardness, tensile strength, and compressive strength due to uniform dispersion of reinforcements.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through nanoindentation, tensile, and compression tests.

papers.title: Femoral Nerve Compression due to Adverse Local Tissue Reaction After Ceramic-on-ceramic Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.abstract: The use of metal bearings in total hip arthroplasty (THA) has been linked with adverse local tissue reactions (ALTRs). There is 1 reported case of ALTR from a ceramic-on-ceramic (CoC) bearing and none that resulted in nerve compression. In this case, a 71-year-old man presented with an ALTR after a CoC THA that resulted in femoral nerve compression. An anterior approach was utilized to revise his THA, which resulted in nerve decompression and near-resolution of his preoperative symptoms. We conclude that CoC bearings may not be completely inert and can result in ALTRs and nerve compression.

summary_en.motivation: To document a rare case of adverse local tissue reaction causing femoral nerve compression after ceramic-on-ceramic total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A single retrospective case report describing patient presentation, imaging findings, and surgical revision via an anterior approach.
summary_en.result: Nerve decompression and near-resolution of preoperative symptoms were achieved after revision surgery.
summary_en.validation: Clinical observation of a single patient case.

papers.title: Influence of the Titanium Carbide Reinforcing Phase Content on Surface Geometric Structure Parameters of H13 Steel-Based Composite Materials Obtained by Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: The paper presents the results of research on the surface geometric structure (SGS) of objects made of H13 tool steel reinforced with titanium carbide (TiC) nanoparticles with a concentration between 2.5 and 15% vol., manufactured using the additive manufacturing method (AM) -selective laser melting (SLM). The variable parameters were the percentage of the reinforcing phase and the spatial orientation of the analysed surfaces, while the SLM process parameters were constant. The altitudinal and spatial SGS parameters obtained for the studied samples and surfaces are summarised and compared. The results showed a strong influence of the reinforcing phase content on the values of the surface roughness parameters -with the significant deterioration noted for samples with min. 10% TiC vol. The resulting surface quality was better for upward-facing than downward-facing produced at the same angle.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究工具钢复合材料的表面粗糙度，与生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surface roughness of SLM-fabricated H13 tool steel with TiC reinforcement, with no biomedical application, no porous structures, no mechanical testing, and no relevance to osseointegration or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同碳化钛含量对SLM制备H13钢复合材料表面几何结构的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备不同TiC含量的复合材料，并用接触轮廓仪测量表面粗糙度参数。
summary_zh.result: TiC含量≥10%时表面粗糙度显著增加，朝上表面质量优于朝下表面。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量对比不同参数下的表面粗糙度数据。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of TiC nanoparticle content on the surface geometric structure of H13 steel composites fabricated by SLM.
summary_en.method: H13 steel with varying TiC content (2.5-15% vol.) was processed via SLM, and surface roughness parameters were measured using a contact profilometer.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness significantly deteriorated at TiC contents of 10% and above, and upward-facing surfaces exhibited better quality than downward-facing surfaces.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of surface roughness across different TiC concentrations and surface orientations.
